What is the exact value of $\tan\left(75^\circ\right)$?

*Hint:* Use the fact that $75^\circ = 30^\circ + 45^\circ$.

What is the exact value of $\tan\left(\frac{5\pi}{12}\right)$?

*Hint:* Use the fact that $\frac{5\pi}{12} = \frac{\pi}{6} + \frac{\pi}{4}$.

What is the exact value of $\tan\left(165^\circ\right)$?

*Hint:* Use the fact that $165^\circ = 30^\circ + 135^\circ$.

What is the exact value of $\tan\left(15^\circ\right)$?

*Hint:* Use the fact that $15^\circ = 45^\circ - 30^\circ$.

What is the exact value of $\tan\left(105^\circ\right)$?

*Hint:* Use the fact that $105^\circ = 45^\circ + 60^\circ$.
